name: Filter models and read a sample image's generation info
description: Verifies the Civitai-style browse flow: filtering cards by category, tag, sort and period, opening a model and seeing prompt, sampler and seed for a sample image.
steps: On the home page click the 'LoRA' category chip
Click the '#스타일' tag chip
Click '다운로드순' and then '주간'
Open the first model card in the grid
Click the first image in the sample image strip
expected: After filtering every card shows the 'LoRA' badge; the model page shows the model name and a '다운로드' button; the image dialog shows a '프롬프트' section with text and a '시드 (Seed)' value.

name: Show prompt overlay on the image feed on mobile
description: Verifies touch users can reveal the prompt overlay with the info button and open the full-size viewer.
steps: Open the '이미지' page from the header navigation
Tap the '생성 정보 보기' info button on the first image
Tap the image itself
expected: After tapping the info button the card shows Sampler, Steps, CFG and Seed values over the image; tapping the image opens a dialog with the image, a '네거티브 프롬프트' or '프롬프트' section and a close button.

name: Block uploads for signed-out visitors
description: Verifies that a visitor who is not signed in cannot reach the upload form.
steps: Without signing in, open the URL path '#/models/new'
Open the URL path '#/images/new'
expected: Both pages show a '로그인이 필요해요' card with a '로그인' button and no upload form fields are shown.

name: Upload a model with a sample image, then delete it
covers: model detail rendering of uploaded content
description: Verifies a signed-in user can publish a model with an uploaded sample image and remove it again.
steps: Sign in
Open '만들기' in the header and choose '모델 업로드'
Click '모델 올리기' without filling anything in
Enter the model name 'QA 테스트 LoRA', choose the 'LoRA' type and the 'SDXL' base model
In the 모델 파일 section enter the external link 'https://huggingface.co/test/qa-model'
Add one PNG or JPEG image as a sample image
Click '모델 올리기'
On the new model page click '삭제' and confirm the dialog
Refresh the home page
expected: The empty submit shows the error '모델 이름을 2자 이상 입력해 주세요.'; after the real submit the model page shows 'QA 테스트 LoRA' with the uploaded image; after deleting and refreshing, 'QA 테스트 LoRA' is no longer listed on the home page.

name: Like a model and keep it after reload
description: Verifies the like toggle is saved per user.
steps: Sign in
Open the model '한복 스타일 LoRA' from the home page
Note the number on the heart like button and click it
Refresh the page
expected: After the click the like button is highlighted and its number increased by one; after the refresh it is still highlighted with the increased number.
